scripts.build: npm run build -w herceg && npm run build -w @herceg/react && npm run build -w @herceg/vue && npm run build -w @herceg/svelte
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p benchmarks && tsc -p packages/herceg && tsc -p packages/react && tsc -p packages/vue && npm run typecheck -w @herceg/svelte && tsc -p python/js
scripts.test:browser: npm run test:browser -w herceg && npm run test:browser -w @herceg/react && npm run test:browser -w @herceg/vue && npm run test:browser -w @herceg/svelte && vitest run --config python/js/vitest.config.ts
scripts.test:python: npm run build:python && cd python && uv run --extra dev pytest
scripts.lint:python: cd python && uv run --extra dev ruff check src tests examples && uv run --extra dev ruff format --check src tests examples && uv run --extra dev mypy
